correctness.rationale: The four ordered dual-exponent equations are equivalent to A=P+B+Q. The complete tau product has exactly the factor (1-q^x)^A vanishing at x=0, and no other factor vanishes there, proving exact multiplicity A.

value.rationale: Askey--Wilson duality and positive reflectionless Toda norming data are two central structures in the motivating source. Their intersection is therefore natural. The theorem shows a sharp incompatibility: only the free wave is both an ordered duality fixed point and in the positive zero-free chamber, while every nontrivial fixed point has an explicit negative index and a central tau zero of exact multiplicity. This is a structural classification rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
